solutionSql:
SELECT id,
       LEFT(tracking_code, 2) AS prefix,
       (booked_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS booked_day
FROM shipments
WHERE id BETWEEN 1 AND 10
ORDER BY id;
notes: Shipments 1 and 2 are booked on 2026-01-31 and 3 to 10 on 2025-12-28, as the ticket says. The UTC cast does not depend on the session time zone.
